review_claim: Issue 80 ePC-SAFT implementation and retained full-range nine-species candidate evidence

findings.finding: None of the four frozen reactive candidates passes the mixed N=8 exact physical-certification gate, so the fail-closed campaign correctly did not begin a complete fit or export a bundle.
The reactive hierarchy remains incomplete: the driver exposes one frozen candidate at a time, and grouped fold refits, one-SE selection, rank/correlation/bound checks, and profiles were not executed.
With no frozen complete candidate, calibration/validation metrics and separate observable-wise validated domains do not exist; Xu2011 and Jakobsen2005 remain untouched as required.

The focused slope test establishes public-model/static-model value equivalence and active-fit AD/centered-difference agreement, but does not independently compare active-fit observable values with ordinary public-model values at an identical state.

all 123 retained states and all 210 pressure/speciation targets are present in each complete candidate input
